scope: CPU mappings of the 64 KiB tokens allocated with Frosty's flags 0x20400000. Coverage includes its section-backed profile 0x23 apertures and ordinary Win32 reservations.
checks: Allocate distinct tokens into a guarded array. Map the pages into the middle of a four-page reservation. Write different patterns across all 131072 bytes.
Unmap using a null token array. Confirm the range returns to MEM_RESERVE. Remap the tokens in reverse order at a different base and verify every byte.

Reject a free while mapped, duplicate or unknown tokens, unaligned mapping, unsupported allocation flags and a stale token. Reject an unmap covering a foreign range and preserve a separate committed page.
Unmap and free individually, verify the neighboring live mapping remains committed, and release the full reservation.
Reserve both profile 0x23 apertures used by Frosty. Map one token three times, verify each of its 65536 bytes through both other addresses and then write back through a separate aperture.

Check a scatter failure leaves its new address reserved and its existing alias intact. Unmap and remap through scatter, transfer bytes through an ordinary VirtualAlloc reservation, restore the two aperture extents, and free physical tokens while their section views are live.

A separate 256-token control mapped 512 simultaneous views across two 16 MiB apertures. Writes through both directions agreed for all 256 pairs. A single physical free restored both full reservations.
implementation: Section-backed apertures replace 64 KiB placeholders with views of a demand-committed section shared by the token batch. Frees remove all of the token's CPU aliases. The independent ordinary-reservation path copies bytes on unmap and remap.
limitations: A full Xbox kernel could not supply reference physical pages on Proton. The CPU-alias contract is inferred from the packaged AWE section construction, allocation driver and the Windows kernel section path.
Ordinary Win32 reservations retain their single-live-mapping profile. CPU views require explicit unmap or physical free before releasing the complete underlying reservation.
GPU page-table mappings, true Xbox physical residency, DirectStorage transfers and Frosty visual performance were not established by this control.

reproduce.provider: python build.py xmem && python tuxbox.py verify --only xmem --output build/xmem-result.json
reproduce.package_control: Copy build/xmem-smoke/xmem-smoke.exe and the package xmem.dll, xbthunk.dll and xcrdapi.dll into an isolated directory. Run the guest with --pages --report result.txt on the selected Proton build with PROTON_LOG=1.

section_contract.reference: Windows 10.0.19041.329 ntoskrnl.exe SHA-256 9923b54ed79b57e1fd609b8226bac634d5167a1afcd0eb06bc79d1f1c274d496. MiAllocateAweInfo receives zero for the single-mapping restriction for an AWE section at RVA 0x82efc7, versus one for the default process AWE pool at RVA 0x8e14d5. MiIncrementAweMapCount at RVA 0x552d4b rejects an additional reference when the restriction is set. The Xbox user-physical section uses the former path.
